items.title: SNEX Q4 Earnings Miss Estimates Despite Revenue Growth, Stock Dips
items.summary: StoneX Group (SNEX) reported Q4 fiscal 2026 EPS of 66 cents, missing estimates by 20 cents, causing shares to drop 2.38%. While full-year net income surged 71.8% to $525.4 million and operating revenues rose 43.8%, the company faced headwinds from weakness in Institutional and Self-Directed/Retail segments, rising expenses, and declining securities revenue per million. Strong performance in Commercial and Payments segments partially offset these challenges.
